A necklace ___2___ three pendants bunched together and a few bangles above the elbow and ___3___ on the right hands display an almost modern art. She speaks of the ___4___, ever hopeful human spirit. Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
options: bangles
toe-rings
ear-rings
anklets
solution:

Explanation:

☛ Logical Elimination: Toe-rings and anklets are foot-related, while ear-rings don’t align with arm adornment. Only bangles (circular hand ornaments) fit the description of arm coverage.
☛ Grammatical Clue: "A series of" requires a plural noun. Bangles is plural and agrees with the body part (arm) mentioned.
☛ Cultural Relevance: In Indian culture, bangles are traditional arm accessories, aligning with the passage’s "almost modern art" theme and museum context. Their stacked appearance (series) matches the visual artistry described.
